name: cc-anchor
description: An anchor card that survives context compaction: goal, invariants, recent tool-call breadcrumbs and your kronicle-lite cursor, written to disk before every compaction and re-injected verbatim after it. Ships a drift statusline and an opt-in lifecycle hooks pack for kronicle-lite / sea-lite (claim guards, session documents, scope guard, task mirror) with a Cursor port.
